name: cookbook
description: Monorepo cookbook : API Node/GraphQL + front React

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @cookbook/api" "npm run dev -w @cookbook/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cookbook/api && npm run build -w @cookbook/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cookbook/api && npm run typecheck -w @cookbook/web
